monetization.noteEs: Compra única (~$70 USD). Tiene una tienda de cosméticos (gestos, pendants, layered armor, decoración del Seikret) y character edit vouchers, todo opcional y puramente estético. Los Title Updates con monstruos, armas y eventos nuevos son gratuitos para todos. Sin nada que compre poder: el gear, las skills y las decoraciones salen del gameplay.
monetization.noteEn: One-time purchase (~$70 USD). It has a cosmetics shop (gestures, pendants, layered armor, Seikret decor) and character edit vouchers, all optional and purely cosmetic. Title Updates with new monsters, weapons, and events are free for everyone. Nothing buys power: gear, skills, and decorations all come from gameplay.
